what: A study firmware: the keys light up to show where to play. A lessons page in Chrome teaches notes, scales, chords and real songs section by section, and imports your own chord sheets (ChordPro). Plays through FM6, six-operator FM with SAVE for your own presets.
author: Wellington Saam
sounds: licensed: FM6 voices from Melodee (Kerem Kilic) and Felucca (Leo Kuroshita), GPL-3.0
